questions: Should the random seed be set only once at the start, or should it be set before each random number generation to ensure reproducibility across different loop orders?
Are the sales values required to be exactly in the range [100, 501), i.e., 100 <= sales < 501, or is the formula randint(100, 500) + uniform(0, 1) definitive even if it could produce 500.999...?
Should the DataFrame rows be sorted in any specific order beyond the loop order (e.g., by Month then Category), or is the loop order sufficient?
If categories or months contain duplicate values, should duplicates be allowed, and if so, how should they be handled in generation?
Is the random seed intended to be set globally (affecting other random calls outside this function) or locally scoped to this function's generation?
Should the sales values be rounded or formatted to a specific number of decimal places, or left as full floating-point precision?
Are the categories and months required to be strings, or can they be any hashable types (e.g., integers, tuples)?
Should the function reset the random state after execution to avoid side effects on subsequent random number generation?
